#!/bin/bash

# This script is a conversion of a wrapper script that submitted an LSF job.
# The variables and commands have been combined into a single Flux batch script.

tf="LEF1"           # example: CTCF
model_dir="$MYTEAM/maxatac/runs/rpe_$tf"    # example: /data/weirauchlab/team/ngun7t/maxatac/runs/run-transformer-4
cell_line="A549"    # example: GM12878
chromosomes="chr1"  # example: chr1
gold_standard="$MYTEAM/maxatac/training_data/ChIP_Peaks/ChIP_Peaks/${cell_line}__$tf.bw"

#BSUB -W 72:00
#FLUX --time=72:00:00

#BSUB -n 8
#BSUB -R 'span[ptile=8]'
# This requests 8 cores on a single node for one task.
#FLUX --nodes=1
#FLUX --ntasks=1
#FLUX --cpus-per-task=8

#BSUB -M 80000
#FLUX --mem-per-task=80000M

#BSUB -q amdgpu
#FLUX --queue=amdgpu

#BSUB -gpu 'num=1'
#FLUX --gpus=1

# NOTE: Flux does not expand shell variables in directives. The output/error
# filenames have been changed to use the standard {name} and {id} tokens.
# You can add a command at the end of the script to rename the files if needed.
#FLUX --job-name=train_pipeline
#FLUX --error=logs/{name}_{id}.err
#FLUX --output=logs/{name}_{id}.out

# load modules
module load bedtools/2.29.2-wrl
module load gcc/9.3.0
module load cuda/11.7
module load samtools/1.6-wrl
module load pigz/2.6.0
module load ucsctools
source activate maxatac
cd $MYTEAM/maxatac/runs

maxatac train \
--genome hg38 \
--arch Transformer_phuc \
--sequence $HOME/opt/maxatac/data/hg38/hg38.2bit \
--meta_file $MYTEAM/maxatac/training_data/meta_file_$tf.tsv \
--output $model_dir \
--prefix transformer \
--epochs 200

best_model=$(cat ${model_dir}/*txt)

maxatac predict \
--model "${best_model}" \
--train_json $model_dir/cmd_args.json \
--signal $MYTEAM/maxatac/training_data/ATAC_Signal_File/ATAC_Signal_File/${cell_line}_RP20M_minmax_percentile99.bw \
--batch_size 100 \
--chromosomes $chromosomes \
--prefix ${tf}_${cell_line}_${chromosomes} \
--multiprocessing False \
--output ${model_dir}/prediction

maxatac benchmark \
--prediction ${model_dir}/prediction/${tf}_${cell_line}_${chromosomes}.bw \
--gold_standard ${gold_standard} \
--prefix ${tf}_${cell_line}_${chromosomes} \
--chromosomes $chromosomes \
--output ${model_dir}/benchmark

issues: The command `best_model=$(cat ${model_dir}/*txt)` is fragile. It assumes exactly one file ending in `.txt` exists in the model directory. If zero or multiple `.txt` files are present, the variable will be empty or contain concatenated text, respectively, which will likely cause the subsequent `maxatac predict` command to fail.

There is a potential hardware/software mismatch. The job requests to run in a queue named `--queue=amdgpu`, which implies the node has an AMD GPU. However, the script loads the `cuda/11.7` module, which is specific to NVIDIA GPUs. If the `amdgpu` queue does not contain NVIDIA GPUs, the CUDA-dependent application will fail to run.
